crewNotes.text: General China traveller allowances (non-resident figures); crew should confirm any crew-specific treatment with GACC. Compiled from official customs guidance, pending final authority review.

rules.text: Non-resident passengers may bring in 1,500 ml of alcoholic drinks (12% ABV or above) duty-free.
Non-resident passengers must declare foreign currency over USD 5,000 (residents over USD 1,000). Chinese yuan has a hard entry limit of CNY 20,000.

declarationRequirements.text: Non-resident visitors may bring in personal goods (excluding alcohol and tobacco) up to a total value of RMB 2,000 duty-free; above that, goods must be declared.

rules.text: Non-resident passengers may bring in 400 cigarettes, or 100 cigars, or 500g of smoking tobacco, duty-free.

disclaimer: Verify current requirements with the relevant authority and airline procedures before travel.

sources.authorityName: General Administration of Customs of China (GACC)
